tables.caption: The antibiotic activity of clavaspirin, its analogue peptides and melittin, erythromycin, gentamicin, ampicillin and piperacidin
footnotes: Minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) were determined in 10 mM sodium phosphate buffer (I, pH 5.5; and II, pH 7.4) containing 10% Luria broth (LB). Drug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus bacteria were isolated from hospitalized otitis media patients (Chonnam National University’s hospital, Korea). This strain (with CCARM number) was obtained from the Culture Collection of Antimicrobial Resistant Microbes in Korea. Cla, Me, Er, Ge, AM and Pi are Clavaspirin, Melittin, erythromycin, gentamicin, ampicillin and piperacidin, respectively. (–) is not determined.
